items.title: Should You Buy Intel Stock Because The Comeback Is Working?
items.summary: Intel (INTC) has been repriced as a comeback over the past year, and the products are cooperating. Revenue reached $16.1 billion in the second quarter of 2026, up 25% from a year earlier, while trailing-twelve-month revenue was up 7.5% to $57.0 billion. The server line is supply-constrained. The harder question is what your money buys at this price.
